briefdescription.para: Free tuple format resources, doesn't unregister.
Try to reuse given format.

detaileddescription.para: This is only possible for formats of ephemeral spaces, since we need to be sure that shared dictionary will never be altered. If it can, then alter can affect another space, which shares a format with one which is altered.

The only way to change the format of the space is to recreate space with the new format inside of BOX. Since there is no mechanism for recreating the ephemeral space, we need not worry about changing the format of the ephemeral space.
